additional_info.subject: RE: WG: ID0482412/DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003341] Charging issue CRM:02681001553
additional_info.body:
Dear Barbara.
Thank you for your feedback
Following your report and after our checks, we identified that the problem was related to DC1 ErrorCode: 33, which occurs when ELMS is configured but inactive.
We have now reconfigured the ELMS, and the charger is working normally.
Please note that I will monitor the charger over the next three days. If the issue appears again, I will take the necessary steps to resolve it.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
